svg.title: VXLAN bridge: flood-and-learn FDB

g.text: h1a pings h2a across the VXLAN bridge; vtep1 knows the h1a MAC locally, but the h2a MAC is still
Unknown unicast: vtep1 floods out its local ports and into the VNI 100 tunnel; vtep2 learns h1a and
h2a replies — vtep2's FDB now maps the h1a MAC to remote VTEP 192.0.2.1, so the reply is unicast, not
Both FDBs are warm — the next h1a→h2a frame is unicast end to end, with no flooding on either bridge.
